criteria.review_type: AI-assisted evidence review; not human assessment
criteria.reviewer_method: OpenAI Codex interactive session model GPT-5, direct inspection of original reviews and frozen saved inputs; no external judge or model API call

labels.supported: Every material clause and qualifier is supported by the cited original review or reviews. A recurring claim requires at least two distinct cited supplied reviews supporting the same complete observation.
labels.partially supported: At least one material element is supported, but another clause, qualifier, recurrence assertion, excerpt, temporal implication, or current-condition implication is not fully supported.
labels.unsupported: The cited evidence supports none of the material claim.
labels.contradicted: The cited evidence directly conflicts with a material claim.
labels.unclear: The source language or relationship to the claim cannot be interpreted confidently.

citation_checks: Review ID occurs in the exact frozen request input
Citation date matches the supplied source
Quoted excerpt is an exact contiguous substring of the prepared source text
semantic_checks: Full original review supports the entire claim
Qualifiers and joined attributes are supported
Recurring wording has at least two distinct citations supporting the same full observation
A dated guest report is not converted into a verified current condition
No selected-review frequency is converted into population prevalence

omission_definitions.supplied_input_omission: Important feedback was present in the review evidence supplied to the profile generator but missing or materially misrepresented in the profile.
omission_definitions.selection_omission: Important feedback was found in a reproducible sample of reviews excluded by automatic review selection; the generator never received it.

criteria.evidence_policy: The generated profile is the object being evaluated and is never evidence for itself. Evidence comes from data/reviews.csv.gz, checked against saved IDs/dates/text, and the exact frozen request inputs.

usage.note: This review used the active Codex session. Per-turn model-token usage is unavailable in the workspace, so no usage figure is invented.

limitations: AI-assisted labels are not independent human judgments.
Semantic entailment and importance involve judgment, especially for compound claims and translated/non-English reviews.
The supplied-input omission log records important findings, not every minor detail absent from a compact profile.
Only 96 of 5,089 excluded reviews were semantically inspected; rare selection losses may be missed.
The diagnostic sample is purposive and does not estimate quality for all Greater Manchester listings.

Great place!

Really enjoyed my stay at Whitworth Locke - check in was easy, the room was clean and the hotel was quiet and well situated. Thanks!

Parfait

Stayed here over a sunny easter weekend with my wife and two year old son. The whole setting is stunning and the cabin is perfect!Well stocked and beautifully decorated. A cosy and comfortable cabin with gorgeous views surrounded by chickens! Incredibly well equipped and furnished beautifully, we had everything we needed here. Had a wonderful night and wished we could have stayed longer!

Thanks for an amazing time whilst hosting us at the cabin. An unbelievable location with stunning views.  Excellent communication and help throughout. We will definately be back : ) All the best, Simon and Nicole
Really nice secluded location

excluded_sampling_rule.population: All excluded reviews, including punctuation-only exclusions, for the four heavy listings
excluded_sampling_rule.rule: Sort excluded rows by date then string review_id. Split sorted ranks into four consecutive blocks using numpy.array_split (larger blocks first). Within each block sort by SHA256(seed|listing_id|review_id) then string review_id; take first 6. No keywords, manual nominations, or known failure cases used.
excluded_sampling_rule.limitations: Time-rank stratification over-samples sparsely populated periods relative to review volume if block sizes differ slightly; fixed small sample can miss rare feedback; no prevalence inference.

uncertain_decisions.uncertainty: The French source says the guests 'found ourselves on the street,' supporting a stranded account, but it does not explicitly locate that event 'upon arrival.'
One source calls the room 'massive' and 'comfy' without explicitly attaching comfort to the bed; the other source explicitly supports both room size and bed comfort.
The full source reports eventual entry, but the generated excerpt stops before that resolution. Full-review semantic support and excerpt coverage therefore differ.
The cited review supports the missing oven but not hot water. A different supplied review supports hot-water trouble, but citations were not silently substituted.
The two citations collectively contain views, peace, privacy and woodland, but each supports a different subset; this does not establish recurrence of the conjunction.
Failed check-in review 496874684 appeared in the fixed hash sample, but it was already a known development case and is not treated as independent validation.
